materials.name: Inconel 718
materials.note: Inconel 718 is a precipitation-hardened Ni-Cr-Fe superalloy used as high-strength, corrosion-resistant billet and forging stock from cryogenic service to elevated-temperature aerospace, energy, and harsh-environment applications.

materials.name: Ti-6Al-4V
materials.note: Ti-6Al-4V is the workhorse α+β titanium alloy used widely as billet, bar, and forging stock, combining high specific strength, corrosion resistance, weldability, and heat-treat response.

materials.name: Waspaloy
materials.note: Waspaloy is a wrought, age-hardenable Ni-base superalloy billet material used for high-strength gas-turbine rotating hardware and other oxidation-resistant elevated-temperature components.
